name: Ulguan Cloak
text: The general is not visible to enemy models that are more than 12" away from it.

name: Blood-River Chalice
text: Once per battle, in your hero phase, Heal (2D3) the general.

name: Rousing Oration
text: In your hero phase, roll a dice for each friendly unit wholly within 12" of the general, not counting the general. For each 5+, the general gains 1 noble deeds point.

name: Crimson Victuals
text: Spell (casting value 6). In your hero phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the general. If the spell is cast, it suffers D3 mortal damage, then your Cryptguard unit within 6" of it gets back 1 slain model per damage point allocated.
